Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations

Class CpaWaterPhaseBoundaryCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.CpaWaterPhaseBoundaryCalculator
public final class CpaWaterPhaseBoundaryCalculator extends Object
Calculates three CPA water-phase boundaries on detached copies of a fully configured fluid.

Characterization, inhibitors, component amounts and fitted parameters are retained. No non-CPA model conversion or gas-only extraction is performed. A liquid-water gas dew point is reported as not applicable when the supplied state already contains a liquid; the ice and hydrate calculations still retain the complete fluid inventory.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim contributors
